_comment: IDE-only tsconfig for the customer sandbox: this is the nearest tsconfig for every file under custom/, so editors and svelte-preprocess pick it up (svelte-preprocess resolves the tsconfig from the FILE's directory). verbatimModuleSyntax must stay: without it TypeScript strips template-only value imports inside <script>, and every surface import crashes in SvelteKit builds with 'X is not defined'. The build (Vite + SvelteKit) resolves aliases from the app/widget configs, so this file must not be used for compilation (noEmit is set).
